test: C4 collapse seed-robustness, held-out clean count across 5 splits [42,7,123,2024,99]
verdict: Collapse DIRECTION holds (full-817=4 always > held-out mean 1.2). But specific '4->1' is SEED-42-SPECIFIC. Held-out clean count swings 0-3; SQ-Llama not clean on seeds 7,99; no cell clean on all 5 splits.
C4_reframe: From 'evaluation design determines verdict (4->1)' to STRONGER claim: 'held-out verdicts are THEMSELVES split-unstable (0-3 clean, median 1) while full-817 is fixed at 4 - the survivor set is largely a resampling artifact.' More damning re held-out reproducibility.
figure_impact: Paired C4 grid stays as single-split snapshot BUT caption must say 'representative split (seed 42)' and text must report across-seed range. 'Sole survivor' framing RETIRED.
SQ-Llama_status: Now triply-weakened: redundant vs token-ent, clean only 3/5 splits, beaten baseline. NOT robust.
decision: C3 = bedrock. C4 = survives but rewritten to split-instability. C1 = demoted (redundant + unstable).
